label: Media & Content
blurb: Outlines a video script, briefs a thumbnail, cuts a transcript into notes and clips, checks chapter timestamps, builds a subtitle cue sheet, and keeps a paper edit inside a runtime. It uses only the material the user provides. It does not invent a view count, a quote, a timestamp, or a guest.
